steps.message: The issue was caused by an unhandled `StopIteration` when a Zero Width Joiner (ZWJ) was the last character in a string during cell length calculation. I added a `try...except StopIteration` block around the `next(iter_characters)` call in `rich/cells.py` to safely handle this edge case. All tests passed.
